answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake and complete verifiable useful work before it can trade or vote. Like a comet that must burn fuel to stay visible, each fake identity costs the attacker real stake and compute, while a lone honest agent pays once. In a frozen tundra of cheap copies, this turns Sybil creation from free into a linearly expensive act, so flooding the market at dawn of a new round quickly drains the attacker instead of rewarding them.
